name: backup
desc: Create a tar.gz backup with a JSON manifest (hashes, sizes), verify archives, and prune by retention

name: bandwidth
desc: Parse ifconfig / ip -s / vnstat / /proc/net/dev counters, compute throughput rates from two samples, and surface drops and errors

name: basicauth
desc: Create and verify htpasswd-style credentials (bcrypt via scrypt/PBKDF2 documented) with an .htaccess snippet

name: certchain
desc: Fetch a host's served certificate chain, verify each link's signature, check ordering, expiry and missing intermediates, and report the root trust path

name: certgen
desc: Generate RSA/EC keys, CSRs and self-signed certificates via openssl, plus base64 one-liners for CSR submission

name: composecheck
desc: Lint docker-compose files for privileged mode, host-exposed ports, missing restart/healthcheck/resource limits and inline secrets

name: cronaudit
desc: Audit crontabs: duplicates, overlapping schedules, world-writable scripts, PATH hijack risk, missing redirection and shell metacharacters

name: cronconvert
desc: Convert schedules both ways: cron expression to systemd OnCalendar and English, OnCalendar to cron, and next-run previews

name: cronlab
desc: Explain/validate cron expressions in English, compute next run times, and convert between formats

name: deploycheck
desc: Run pre-deploy checks: env parity, secrets in repo, untracked files, build artifacts, git cleanliness

name: diskusage
desc: Walk directories for size and inode usage, report the biggest files and directories, and diff against a saved baseline snapshot

name: dnspropagate
desc: Query a record type across public resolvers over UDP, report answer disagreement, per-resolver latency and an overall propagation verdict

name: dockerclean
desc: Report dangling images, stopped containers, orphan volumes and build cache; emit a safe/aggressive cleanup plan

name: dockerfilecheck
desc: Dockerfile lint: latest tags, root user, ADD vs COPY, secrets in ARG/ENV, layer bloat, missing HEALTHCHECK and multi-stage opportunities

name: dotenvgen
desc: Produce .env/.env.example/.env.docker from a single schema file with secret generation and validation

name: envcheck
desc: Diff a .env against .env.example: find missing, extra, empty and duplicate keys (CI gate)

name: envdiff
desc: Diff two environments (dotenv files or KEY=value dumps): added, removed, changed keys with secret values masked

name: envrc
desc: Parse .envrc: list exports and PATH changes, flag arbitrary shell execution, network fetches and missing `use` allow directives

name: firewalldiff
desc: Dump iptables/nftables/ufw rules, flag dangerous accepts, and diff against a saved baseline
usage: node tools/firewalldiff.js --save baseline.json  |  node tools/firewalldiff.js --diff baseline.json

name: gitstats
desc: Repo stats: commits per author, churn per file, busiest hours, stale branches, TODO debt count

name: gru
desc: Audit /etc/passwd and /etc/group: UID 0 accounts, empty passwords, sudo membership, shell inventory, staleness

name: healthcheck
desc: Poll a URL until it returns expected status/body, with interval, retries and total-time budget

name: htpasswdgen
desc: Generate .htpasswd entries (apr1, sha1, scrypt, pbkdf2) as a batch from a CSV or prompts, with a verify mode and duplicate detection

name: imagetag
desc: Sort semver-ish image tags, find the newest patch per minor, and flag mutable, stale and non-conforming tags

name: incidentlog
desc: Parse incident logs into a normalised timeline, compute MTTD/MTTA/MTTR, and detect recurrence patterns by service and cause

name: k8scheck
desc: Audit Kubernetes YAML manifests for privileged containers, root users, latest tags, missing probes/limits and hostPath mounts

name: kvmreport
desc: Parse libvirt domain XML: vCPU/memory allocation, disk and network devices, host-passthrough CPU and autostart flags

name: lbcheck
desc: Probe upstream backends over HTTP(S), report status/serving state, pairwise response consistency and retry-aware flapping detection

name: logparse
desc: Parse nginx/apache access logs: top IPs, paths, status mix, scanners, and attack signatures

name: mailauth
desc: Check SPF (all-qualifier, lookup count), DMARC (policy, rua, pct), DKIM selector presence, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, with a spoofability verdict

name: makefile
desc: Parse a Makefile: list targets with doc comments, show variables, and flag .PHONY gaps plus dangerous targets

name: nfsmount
desc: Parse /etc/exports and mount options, flag insecure settings (no_root_squash, insecure, no_subtree_check, wildcard hosts) and recommend safe defaults

name: nginxgen
desc: Generate production nginx server blocks: static, reverse proxy, websocket, PHP-FPM, redirect, TLS

name: pathaudit
desc: Analyse PATH (or an explicit list) for world-writable directories, relative entries, duplicate binaries and shadowed system commands

name: pkgdiff
desc: Diff dependencies between two package.json/composer.json/lockfiles: added, removed, bumped, risky majors

name: playbookaudit
desc: Heuristic Ansible playbook audit: shell/command usage, become risks, plaintext vars, missing changed_when and ignore_errors

name: portforward
desc: Build ssh -L/-R/-D tunnel commands plus jump-host chains from a declarative JSON spec, with ready-to-paste config blocks

name: portmap
desc: Map listening sockets to owning processes and flag unexpected public binds

name: runbookgen
desc: Turn a service manifest (deps, healthcheck, contacts, escalation) into a markdown runbook with diagnosis, rollback and escalation steps

name: smarthealth
desc: Parse smartctl -a output: reallocated/pending sectors, wear levelling, temperature, power-on hours and a failure-risk heuristic

name: sshconfig
desc: Map jump-host topology and audit ssh_config security/keepalive options, reporting which Host entries are unreachable or unsafe

name: sslrenew
desc: Check certificates for renewal, list the exact renewal commands, and land SNI hostname grouping

name: syssnap
desc: Collect CPU, memory, disk, load, uptime, top processes into one snapshot with a health verdict

name: systemdunit
desc: Analyse .service units: sandboxing directives present/missing, restart policy, resource limits and capability scope

name: terraformaudit
desc: Scan .tf files for public S3 ACLs, 0.0.0.0/0 ingress, unencrypted volumes, wildcard IAM and hardcoded secrets

name: tlsgrade
desc: Grade a TLS endpoint A+ to F: protocol versions, cipher strength, forward secrecy, certificate chain, OCSP stapling, HSTS and key size

name: uptimecalc
desc: Compute availability, error budget, remaining budget and burn rate from a list of incident durations and an SLO target

name: wpconfig
desc: Audit wp-config.php + .htaccess: salts, debug flags, file edit, DB prefix, table_prefix, exposed backups
